_about: Overrides for tools/local_measure_money.py: pin a Cal-Access committee (filer id) to a contest when its name does not match automatically, or exclude a false match. Each entry needs a reason. netfile_names maps NetFile committees whose Filer_ID shows 'Pending' to their Cal-Access id.

1481842.reason: Oakland Residents for Good Government: its organizer Ben Gould signed the official argument against Measure EE as 'Organizer, Oakland Residents for Good Government' (county voter guide p. 936).

1496594.reason: 'Yes on Measure B - Residents and Businesses for a Stronger Emeryville': Emeryville's only measure on this ballot is BB (business tax); the committee name predates or misstates the letter.

1495170.reason: 'Yes on H - San Mateans for Quality City Services': the City of San Mateo sales tax (Measure H); it also filed the official argument in favor. 'San Mateans' doesn't match the place keyword.

1494606.reason: 'Yes for Liberty Union Schools': Liberty Union High School District's only measure on this ballot is X (school bond).

1478885.name: Yes for Quality High Schools - Yes on W 2026
1478885.reason: Acalanes Union High School District's Measure W committee; registered in 2025, before the cycle cutoff, so the automatic match skips it.

1496526.name: Committee to Support Measure II
1496526.reason: Union City's Measure II committee (files with Alameda County); its name has no place word.
